value.rationale: The graph is a canonical smallest cubic symmetric configuration graph. The result identifies a natural sharp deficiency-one mobility threshold, decomposes the reconfiguration graph into maximum-parent K5 blocks with a self-referential line-graph quotient, and exactly quantifies exchange distances. These structural facts are not mere restatements of an induced matching number or arbitrary numerical slice.
